svg.aria-label: Reflection discovers your types at runtime on every start; a source generator does that work once at build time and writes plain C#

g.text: Reflection
"What properties does OrderDto have?"
Read metadata, look up names as strings,
box every value. On every single start.
Rename a property: it still compiles…
and breaks at runtime, by string.
Native AOT / trimming can't see string
lookups, so needed code gets removed.
Source generator
A compiler plugin reads your code and
WRITES plain C#, compiled in with yours.
OrderDtoJson.g.cs (generated)
Run time: nothing to discover
✓ Fast startup: the work was done at build
✓ No boxing, no string lookups
✓ Rename a property and the build fails
(where you can see it)
✓ The trimmer can see everything, so
Native AOT works
e.g. [JsonSerializable], [LoggerMessage]
